notes:
- New: Symbol Properties (right-click a chart) - filter a symbol's data by session or a custom date range, applied consistently to the chart AND any backtest or optimization run on it
- New: Download Individual Symbol (Yahoo, daily) - its own Market dropdown, so it can no longer borrow the wrong exchange suffix from whatever's selected elsewhere
- New: Optimize This Instrument's live "Best so far" is now a real table (Ret%, Net Profit, Sharpe, Win Rate, Max DD across In-Sample / Out-Sample / Total) instead of one line of text
- New: Optimize This Instrument remembers its last completed run - close the dialog to check the chart, reopen it, and your results are still there
- New: Performance Report gains Largest Win / Largest Loss ($) and Win Streak / Loss Streak
- Faster: indicators with no long lookback (like Session Boxes) now compute only over the visible chart window - up to 50x faster on years of intraday data
- Fixed: a data, resample, or backtest failure inside Optimize This Instrument used to fail silently, showing a table of plain 0.0s indistinguishable from a strategy that genuinely found nothing. Errors now surface directly, with a diagnostic that tells apart "no signals found" from "signals found, but none became a trade"
- Fixed: Optimize This Instrument was silently ignoring a symbol's Symbol Properties filter and any session-only Settings > Exits override - both now match the chart exactly
- Fixed: CSV import could silently strip a symbol name like @NQ down to NQ, and could misread day-first dates depending on what else was in the file
- Fixed: Performance Report's dollar P&L now correctly accounts for position sizing instead of assuming one contract for every trade
- Small polish: Futures Contract spec form redesigned into a cleaner two-column layout
